stream.formula: implied total: home (total + spread) / 2, away (total - spread) / 2, from the last pre-kickoff capture; spread is positive when the home side is favoured
stream.not_used: dome and weather are not used: no source for them is loaded
stream.availability_reason: available means the league's free-agent pool lists a player at that position on that team, as of 2026-10-28T16:58:52.640222+00:00; the pool came back at its cap, so a unit not listed is 'not seen available', not 'rostered'

waiver.label: provisional
waiver.caveat: provisional rule (ADR-0014), not a measured edge: no gate has run on this ordering; it is journalled so one can
waiver.basis: value = the free agent's ESPN projection per game minus that of the lowest-projected non-IR rostered player at his position (ESPN's own points, unshrunk); rest-of-season totals and bye_ahead are shown, not used
waiver.shrinkage: unshrunk: the empirical-Bayes player model (#497) is not built, so a top-of-the-pool projection is biased upward by the selection that put it there
waiver.shown_not_sorted: snap_delta, ecr, week_proj and percent_owned are shown beside each row and never enter the value or the order (ADR-0013, ADR-0016)
waiver.faab: no bid is sized: nothing here measures what the room would pay
